devArtifact.usage: incumbent comparison, candidate selection, fixed-threshold evaluation, and error analysis

finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.
model: RoBERTa 12-layer, 28-output checkpoint with the fixed Product-18 projection

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

selectionMetric: Dev Product-18 all-label Macro-F1 subject to all nine frozen Selective Dev guards
stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on PASS_DEV, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run
